name: Audit D-04: global user state needs the permission in tenant 1
description: Users are global: lock, disable, enable, delete, password, identities, profile data, MFA and the blacklist apply to the user everywhere. An admin holding every users/mfa permission in tenant B is rejected (32001); the same permissions in tenant 1 work whatever _tenant_id is passed; self-service (own password, own profile, own identity link) needs no permission. Runs as non-system users (user 1 bypasses every check).
